b.v: USDA Prime > USDA Choice > USDA Select > Standard > Commercial > Utility > Cutter > Canner
b.w: USDA grade rests on marbling and age; Prime is rare, mostly at specialist counters.
The quality number is the lowest of four sub-scores; A5 needs a marbling score of 8-12.
Wagyu, Angus and heritage breeds lead premium shops; a wagyu label alone is not top grade.
Grass-fed, grain-finished and pasture-raised are the first premium filters.
Younger animals grade higher at equal marbling in the USDA system.
